commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul after Mathys Tel (Tottenham) hacks down one of his opponents.
90+6' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) trips an opposition player and Peter Bankes signals a foul.
90+4' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
90+4' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Peter Bankes had an easy-decision to make.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) replaces Morgan Gibbs-White.
90+2' Matz Sels (Nottingham) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90+1' Peter Bankes blows his whistle and it's Richarlison (Tottenham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Ben Davies (Tottenham) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
90' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
89' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Ryan Yates (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.
87' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Richarlison (Tottenham) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Pedro Porro and scores magnificently from close range into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
86' A player from Nottingham brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
84' Djed Spence (Tottenham) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
83' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

82' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
81' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
81' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) replacing Pape Matar Sarr.
80' Richarlison (Tottenham) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Matz Sels, who pulls off a stunning save!
77' The attendance is 59314.
76' Substitution. Chris Wood will be replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).

75' Mathys Tel sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of Richarlison (Tottenham), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.

72' Kevin Danso (Tottenham) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
71' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
67' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) replaces Dejan Kulusevski.
67' That will be all from Wilson Odobert who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Brennan Johnson (Tottenham).

67' Richarlison (Tottenham) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Matz Sels anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
65' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
65' Poor challenge! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is penalised for tripping and Peter Bankes blows his whistle.
63' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) meets a cross and produces a header towards the left side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
63' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) will take the corner.
63' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
60' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Nottingham win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
60' Neco Williams (Nottingham) brings his opponent down. Peter Bankes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
59' Djed Spence (Tottenham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Danilo and he is replaced by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham).
58' That's the end of the game for Nicolas Dominguez, who is replaced by Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
56' Peter Bankes blows his whistle after Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
56' One of the players from Nottingham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

55' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
54' So close! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
54' A cross into the box picks out Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot well wide of the left post.
52' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Djed Spence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
47' Tottenham couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Matz Sels (Nottingham) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
46' Half-time substitution. Cristian Gabriel Romero will not participate anymore and Kevin Danso (Tottenham) is coming on.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Micky van de Ven comes off for Ben Davies (Tottenham).
46' Nuno Espirito Santo makes a switch. Morato is coming on in place of Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Richarlison (Tottenham) latches onto a lofted pass from Mathys Tel on the edge of the six-yard box, but misdirects his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
43' Murillo (Nottingham) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
42' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
42' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Peter Bankes signals.
42' Richarlison (Tottenham) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
40' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the left post. Very poor attempt.
37' Richarlison (Tottenham) is penalised for a foul. Peter Bankes had a clear view and blows his whistle.
32' The linesman raises his flag. Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is adjudged offside.

31' A mistake by a defender gifts Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
29' The referee blows his whistle as Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
27' Peter Bankes blows the whistle, Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) is penalised for a foul.
25' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Matz Sels.
23' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) meets a cross from Pedro Porro, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
21' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
20' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
20' The corner is swung in but Tottenham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

20' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Matz Sels sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner. Tottenham get a corner.

16' 0 - 2 Anthony Elanga sends a superb cross into the box. Chris Wood (Nottingham) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the bottom right corner, leaving Guglielmo Vicario beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 0:2.
16' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham). Peter Bankes saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Nottingham will take a free kick.
14' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
13' Tottenham force their opponents to concede a corner.
13' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee blows his whistle, Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
12' Celebrations are cut short for Nottingham as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
11' The Nottingham players halt their celebrations as referee Peter Bankes makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
10' Goal! Elliot Anderson sends a precise cross into the box, Chris Wood (Nottingham) latches on to it and puts the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) shoots from distance and his effort takes a nick off the defender and goes past Guglielmo Vicario. 0:1.
5' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) prepares to take a corner kick.
4' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Guglielmo Vicario was alert and made a comfortable save.
3' One of the Nottingham players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
2' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Nottingham will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Peter Bankes.
